custom_logic_notes: This is a NEWS trading EA that places BuyStop and SellStop pending orders at a fixed distance (InpStep) from the current price on every tick. When no buy-side exposure exists (no buy position + no buy stop order), it places a BuyStop at Ask+ExtStep. Same for sell side. Pending order prices are continuously trailed to follow the current price, with a TimeModify cooldown (default 300 seconds) and a minimum distance change threshold (ExtStepTrall). The EA also implements break-even logic (NoLoss) and a trailing stop for open positions. The comment 'news' is used for all orders. This is a straddle/breakout strategy designed for news events - it places orders on both sides and trails them tighter as the price moves, catching whichever direction the market breaks.
python_conversion_notes: This EA requires tick-level data for accurate backtesting because: (1) Pending order prices are trailed on every tick, not just on bar close. (2) The TimeModify cooldown and ExtStepTrall distance checks operate on tick timestamps. (3) Entry is via BuyStop/SellStop pending orders, not market orders - the order placement and modification logic must be simulated tick-by-tick. The position_gate logic is 'no same side' - it checks both open positions AND pending orders of the same direction before placing a new pending order. Break-even and trailing stop logic for open positions is standard and can be converted. The pending order trailing logic is the hardest part: order prices are recalculated each tick and only modified if enough time has passed (TimeModify seconds) and the price has moved enough (ExtStepTrall points). A Python conversion should use a tick-by-tick simulator with pending order book support.
